name: Bridging different types of data together
gist: Papers connect vision and language, audio and text, and multiple views of the same object by learning representations that make different data types comparable and usable together.
explain: Real-world data often comes in multiple forms: an image with a caption, a video with audio and text, a medical scan with a patient history. Humans understand how these pieces connect because our brains naturally link different types of input — reading the caption enriches what we see in the image, hearing speech narrows down what we notice in a video. But for a machine to learn from this, representations of images, text, and audio need to be in a shared space where they can be compared and aligned. If you train separately, each modality lives in its own world and they never communicate with each other.

The difficulty is that different modalities have different structures. An image is a spatial grid of pixels, text is a sequence of words, audio is a sequence of waveforms. They are not naturally comparable. Researchers address this by learning alignment: train a model so that an image's representation and its caption's representation are close together in a shared number-space, while mismatched pairs are far apart. This is conceptually similar to contrastive learning, but applied across modalities. The challenge is ensuring alignment happens at the right level: a model might trivially solve this by learning that if an image contains a dog and the text says 'dog,' they match, without learning anything deeper about visual or linguistic structure.

Across 63 papers, researchers develop methods for image-text (like CLIP), audio-text, video-text, and even rarer combinations. The payoff is large: models trained to align vision and language have become the foundation for visual question answering, image search, and text-guided image generation. Papers explore different loss functions, different sampling strategies for constructing positive and negative pairs, and how to handle missing modalities or noisy alignment labels. The success of these methods has shown that self-supervised multimodal learning often works better than any single-modality approach because each modality provides complementary information — text grounds the visual content in language meaning, and images constrain the many possible meanings of text.

papers.title: Advancing Analytic Class-Incremental Learning through Vision-Language Calibration
papers.contribution: Consistently yields superior performance across eight benchmarks, particularly in fine-grained and long-sequence scenarios, maintaining efficiency while overcoming brittleness.

papers.title: Building spatial world models from sparse transitional episodic memories
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that neuroscience-inspired episodic memory principles enable rapid map construction, enabling near-optimal exploration and navigation without additional training.

papers.title: Characterizing Human Semantic Navigation in Concept Production as Trajectories in Embedding Space
papers.contribution: Distinguishes between clinical groups and concept types across four datasets and languages, offering a mathematical framework requiring minimal human intervention.

papers.title: Dual-Branch Representations with Dynamic Gated Fusion and Triple-Granularity Alignment for Deep Multi-View Clustering
papers.contribution: DREAM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art multi-view clustering approaches on benchmark datasets.

papers.title: Exploring Cross-Modal Flows for Few-Shot Learning
papers.contribution: Compared with one-step PEFT methods, FMA has the multi-step rectification ability to achieve more precise and robust alignment.

papers.title: GradPCA: Leveraging NTK Alignment for Reliable Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.contribution: GradPCA achieves more consistent OOD detection performance across benchmarks with theoretical perspective on spectral detection properties enabled by NTK alignment.

papers.title: Improving Diffusion Models for Class-imbalanced Training Data via Capacity Manipulation
papers.contribution: Consistently and significantly improves robustness on imbalanced datasets, delivering greater benefits when combined with existing methods.

papers.title: Improving Semantic Proximity in English-Centric Information Retrieval through Cross-Lingual Alignment
papers.contribution: Significantly improves cross-lingual retrieval performance while mitigating English-inclination problem across most multilingual embedding models.

papers.title: PHyCLIP: $\ell_1$-Product of Hyperbolic Factors Unifies Hierarchy and Compositionality in Vision-Language Representation Learning
papers.contribution: PHyCLIP outperforms single-space approaches on zero-shot classification, retrieval, hierarchical classification, and compositional understanding tasks with more interpretable embedding structures.

papers.title: See, Act, Adapt: Active Perception for Unsupervised Cross-Domain Visual Adaptation via Personalized VLM-Guided Agent
papers.contribution: Performance improvements of 13.54% on visual grounding, 15.92% on segmentation, and 27.68% on 3D box estimation on ReplicaCAD without downstream labels or retraining.

papers.title: The Convergent Representation of Contrastive Vision-Language Models: Geometry, Modality Gap and Shared Space Alignment
papers.contribution: Proposes Shared Space Alignment (SSA) improving MCL pretraining by enhancing alignment without modality gap reduction; validated theory with improved empirical results.

papers.title: APT: Towards Universal Scene Graph Generation via Plug-in Adaptive Prompt Tuning
papers.contribution: APT achieves +2.7 improvement in mR@100 on PredCls, +3.6 gain in F@100, and up to +6.0 gain in mR@50 with less than 0.5M additional parameters and 7.8-25% reduced training time.

papers.title: Attentive Multi-Layer Fusion for Vision Transformers
papers.contribution: Achieves consistent gains over standard linear probes on 20 diverse datasets and multiple pretrained models, with tasks different from pre-training benefiting most.

papers.title: Better Together: Leveraging Unpaired Multimodal Data for Stronger Unimodal Models
papers.contribution: Theoretically shows unpaired auxiliary data yields representations strictly more informative than unimodal training; empirically improves downstream performance across diverse unimodal targets.

papers.title: Beyond Instance-Level Alignment: Dual-Level Optimal Transport for Audio-Text Retrieval
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art audio-text retrieval performance with particularly strong gains under scarce labels and small batch sizes.

papers.title: Beyond Single Embedding: Modeling User Preferences as Distribution in Federated Recommendation
papers.contribution: Distributional formulation yields more stable ranking behavior and improved robustness under ambiguous feedback on federated recommendation benchmarks.

papers.title: BioCAP: Exploiting Synthetic Captions Beyond Labels in Biological Foundation Models
papers.contribution: BioCAP achieves strong performance on species classification and text-image retrieval by capturing rich semantics through caption-guided training.

papers.title: Breaking Gradient Temporal Collinearity for Robust Spiking Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on visual classification benchmarks in robustness while maintaining representational capacity.

papers.title: CARE: Class-Adaptive Expert Consensus for Reliable Learning with Long-Tailed Noisy Labels
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 3.0% performance gains on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks by recalibrating class distributions more reliably.

papers.title: CLIP Behaves like a Bag-of-Words Model Cross-modally but not Uni-modally
papers.contribution: A simple linear transformation to text embeddings improves CLIP's attribute-object binding performance while enabling interpretable semantic concept alignment.

papers.title: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation without Paired Data: Theoretical Foundation and Algorithm
papers.contribution: The framework achieves significant improvements over prior work on unpaired and paired benchmarks with theoretical guarantees.

papers.title: DVLA-RL: Dual-Level Vision–Language Alignment with Reinforcement Learning Gating for Few-Shot Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves new state-of-the-art performance with class-specific discrimination and generalized representations from few support samples through precise cross-modal alignment.

papers.title: Deep Discriminative Structure Proxy Hashing for Cross-modal Retrieval
papers.contribution: Consistently improves cross-modal retrieval accuracy and embedding separability across standard benchmarks.

papers.title: DiL: Discrete-anchored Representation Alignment for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning
papers.contribution: DiL achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse semi-supervised continual learning protocols.

papers.title: DiffSDA: Unsupervised Diffusion Sequential Disentanglement Across Modalities
papers.contribution: DiffSDA outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods on sequential disentanglement across diverse real-world modalities.

papers.title: Diffusion Bridge Variational Inference for Deep Gaussian Processes
papers.contribution: Consistently outperformed DDVI in predictive accuracy, convergence speed, and sample efficiency across regression, classification, and reconstruction tasks.

papers.title: Distributional Vision-Language Alignment by Cauchy-Schwarz Divergence
papers.contribution: CS-Aligner addresses the alignment-uniformity conflict inherent in InfoNCE, enabling tighter alignment and incorporation of unpaired data and token-level representations.

papers.title: Dual-stage Contrastive Learning-enhanced Multi-view Variational Clustering
papers.contribution: The method shows consistent improvements over strong baselines across six real-world datasets with validated component contributions.

papers.title: EmBrace: A Collective Knowledge Fusion Framework Toward Unified EEG Foundation Models
papers.contribution: EmBrace consistently improves over state-of-the-art EFMs and generalizes effectively under cross-task settings by leveraging diverse inductive biases from multiple models.

papers.title: Fine-Grained Class-Conditional Distribution Balancing for Debiased Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves performance on par with bias-supervised approaches on binary classification and significantly outperforms them on highly biased multi-class and multi-shortcut scenarios without bias labels.

papers.title: Flow for Future: Geometric SE(3)-Equivariant Flow Matching for 3D Trajectory Prediction
papers.contribution: Guarantees theoretical SE(3)-equivariance and achieves SOTA accuracy on MD17, MD22, and CMU MoCap benchmarks for geometric trajectory prediction.

papers.title: GFD-EMVC: Evolutionary Multi-View Classification with Label Noise via Gradient and Feature Dual-Perception
papers.contribution: Effectively purifies data and alleviates fitness evaluation bias, improving performance of various multi-view learning paradigms in label noise scenarios.

papers.title: Gauge-invariant representation holonomy
papers.contribution: Holonomy separates models that appear similar under CKA, correlates with adversarial and corruption robustness, and tracks training dynamics.

papers.title: Geometric Embedding Alignment via Curvature Matching in Transfer Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves at least 14.4% improvement on molecular task pairs under random splits and 8.3% under scaffold splits.

papers.title: Giving Sensors a Voice: Multimodal JEPA for Semantic Time-Series Embeddings
papers.contribution: Strong performance across anomaly detection, classification, forecasting using only linear probes; text descriptions enable cross-dataset generalization.

papers.title: Hyperbolic Multimodal Continual Learning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates effective approach on continual multimodal benchmarks that preserves essential geometric structure and hierarchical geometry while enabling task adaptation.

papers.title: Identifiability and recoverability in self-supervised models
papers.contribution: We prove statistical ε-near-identifiability for representations in models like MAEs and GPTs, show ICA resolves remaining linear ambiguity, and provide a recipe for disentanglement.

papers.title: Intra-Modal Neighbors Never Lie: Rectifying Inter-Modal Noisy Correspondence via Graph-Based Intra-Modal Reasoning
papers.contribution: IN2R synthesizes continuous soft prototypes reflecting local semantic consensus on Flickr30K, MS-COCO, and CC152K, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

papers.title: Label-Guided Representation Learning for Incomplete Multi-View Multi-Label Classification
papers.contribution: LGRL demonstrates effectiveness across benchmark datasets and real-world applications in sports analytics and medical imaging.

papers.title: Learning with Admissibility: Robust Fuzzy Hashing for Cross-Modal Retrieval with Noisy Labels
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance on multiple benchmarks through reliable supervision from noisy labels and stable, diverse representations.

papers.title: Learning with Dual-level Noisy Correspondence for Multi-modal Entity Alignment
papers.contribution: RULE demonstrates effectiveness on five benchmarks against dual-level noisy correspondence compared to seven state-of-the-art methods.

papers.title: Local Hessian Spectral Filtering for Robust Intrinsic Dimension Estimation
papers.contribution: Achieves superior robustness for LID estimation and detects memorization in large-scale diffusion models.

papers.title: MIND: Decoupling Model-Induced Label Noise via Latent Manifold Disentanglement
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms SOTA on controlled CIFAR-100 and structural stress tests on 3D datasets, effectively correcting Vision-Language Model zero-shot hallucinations.

papers.title: Multi-Way Representation Alignment
papers.contribution: Consistently improves any-to-any retrieval while retaining a practical shared reference space for model stitching.

papers.title: Multimodal Classification via Total Correlation Maximization
papers.contribution: TCMax outperforms state-of-the-art joint and unimodal learning approaches by alleviating modality competition while capturing inter-modal interactions.

papers.title: NNiT: Width-Agnostic Neural Network Generation with Structurally Aligned Weight Spaces
papers.contribution: On ManiSkill3 robotics tasks, NNiT achieves $>85\%$ success on architecture topologies unseen during training, while baseline approaches fail to generalize; the same pipeline also generalizes to MNIST classification beyond the robotic control setting

papers.title: OrthoRF: Exploring Orthogonality in Object-Centric Representations
papers.contribution: Matches or outperforms existing models on unsupervised object discovery, recovers occluded object parts, and produces more interpretable representations.

papers.title: PIRN: Prototypical-based Intra-modal Reconstruction with Normality Communication for Multi-modal Anomaly Detection.
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms prior methods on standard benchmarks while handling few-shot scenarios by leveraging complementary normal cues across modalities.

papers.title: Rank-guided Diffusion for Noise Few-Shot Learning
papers.contribution: Significantly reduces errors under noise levels up to 40% across MiniImageNet and TieredImageNet by mitigating prototype drift through low-rank geometry.

papers.title: Riemannian Metric Matching for Scalable Geometric Modeling of Distributions
papers.contribution: Rivals or improves accuracy of k-NN-based diffusion geometry while enabling amortized inference up to 400x faster; supports graph-free geometric analysis on high-dimensional images.

papers.title: Robust Self-reflective Hashing for Cross-modal Retrieval with Noisy Label
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing methods with improved robustness and reliability on benchmark datasets.

papers.title: SOTAlign: Semi-Supervised Alignment of Unimodal Vision and Language Models via Optimal Transport
papers.contribution: Effectively leverages unpaired images and text to learn robust joint embeddings, significantly outperforming supervised and semi-supervised baselines across datasets and encoder pairs.

papers.title: Steering Embedding Models with Geometric Rotation: Mapping Semantic Relationships Across Languages and Models
papers.contribution: RISE consistently maps discourse-level transformations across languages and models, supporting Linear Representation Hypothesis.

papers.title: Supporting Multimodal Intermediate Fusion with Informatic Constraint and Distribution Coherence
papers.contribution: Establishes theoretical evidence for IF superiority; demonstrates eliminating distribution incoherence improves IF-based MML generalizability.

papers.title: The Perception–Physics Paradox: Probing Scientific Alignment with TC-Bench
papers.contribution: Analysis shows that current VFMs rely on visual shortcuts that collapse in extreme regimes, indicating that scientific alignment does not arise as a natural byproduct of visual scaling alone.

papers.title: Trajectory Seriation via Spectral Tangent Alignment and Global Embedding
papers.contribution: Provides finite-sample Kendall's τ recovery bound explicit in curvature, noise, and sampling density, with accurate fast order recovery on synthetic curves and meaningful pseudotime on single-cell RNA-seq.

papers.title: Transformed Latent Variable Multi-Output Gaussian Processes
papers.contribution: T-LVMOGP scales to over 10,000 outputs while capturing meaningful inter-output dependencies, outperforming baselines on diverse benchmarks.

papers.title: UniCon: Unified Framework for Efficient Contrastive Alignment via Kernels
papers.contribution: UniCon achieves substantial efficiency gains while preserving generality and strong empirical performance on synthetic, unimodal, multimodal, and zero-shot tasks.

papers.title: UniFast-HGR: Scalable and Efficient Maximal Correlation for Multimodal Models
papers.contribution: Consistent gains across retrieval, classification, and emotion recognition with O(m^2K) structural cost and stable behavior at extreme feature dimensions.

papers.title: Universal Algorithm-Implicit Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on few-shot benchmarks while generalizing to unseen domains and modalities, solving text/audio tasks despite training only on images, and handles 20× more classes than training.

papers.title: VisionTrim: Unified Vision Token Compression for Training-Free MLLM Acceleration
papers.contribution: Advances practical MLLM deployment through superior performance across diverse image and video multimodal benchmarks.

papers.title: WAVE: Learning Unified & Versatile Audio-Visual Embeddings with Multimodal LLM
papers.contribution: WAVE sets state-of-the-art on MMEB-v2 video benchmark and achieves superior results in audio and video-to-audio retrieval tasks.

papers.title: WeightCLIP: Aligning Datasets and Models for Weight Space Learning
papers.contribution: Explicitly incorporating dataset information improves weight-space representations for retrieval, generation, and refinement tasks, with latent refinement outperforming standard fine-tuning.
